eyebrow: Git & GitHub for Software Engineers · Chapter 4, Lesson 20
subtitle: A PR and a real merge are different events — they need different jobs

code:
build-and-test:
  # runs on every push AND pull_request

deploy:
  needs: build-and-test
  if: github.event_name == 'push' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
caption: Every PR gets checked. Only a real merge to main deploys.

eyebrow: Credentials never go in plain text
code:
deploy:
    steps:
      - run: npm run deploy
        env:
          DEPLOY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
caption: Secrets inject as env vars and are automatically masked — *** — in any log output.
